pass_a_gloss: Apostles-only oracles in triple catena; sparrows, hairs, confession; friends not slaves.
pass_b_english: Observe further: the prophecies and promises concerning martyrdom were said to the apostles alone. Hear Matthew: 'Behold, I send you as sheep in wolves' (Matthew 10:16–23,28–33) midst. Be wise as serpents, guileless as doves. Beware of men: they shall hand you to councils, and scourge you in synagogues; and before governors and kings shall ye be brought for my sake, for testimony to them and the nations. But when they hand you, be not anxious how or what ye speak: it shall be given you in that hour what ye speak. For not ye speak, but your Father's Spirit speaks in you. Brother shall hand brother to death, and father child; children shall rise against parents and kill them. And ye shall be hated by all for my name: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved. When they persecute you in this city, flee to another.' And Luke: 'Settle in your hearts not to practice apology: for I will give you mouth and wisdom, which all opposers cannot withstand or contradict. Ye shall be handed by parents and brethren and kin and friends, and kill some of you; and ye shall be hated by all for my name. And a hair of your head shall not perish. In your patience possess ye your souls.' (Luke 21:14–19) And Mark: 'Take heed to yourselves: they shall hand you to councils and synagogues; ye shall be beaten, and stand before governors and kings for my sake, for testimony to them. And to all nations must the Gospel first be preached. And when they lead handing you, be not anxious beforehand what ye speak; but what be given you in that hour, speak: for not ye speak, but the Holy Spirit. Brother shall hand brother to death, and father child; children shall rise against parents and kill them. And ye shall be hated by all for my name: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.' (Mark 13:9–13) Fear not then those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul: 'fear him who can destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.' (Mark 8:38) Are not two sparrows sold for a penny, and one falls not without the Father? But even your head's hairs are all numbered. Whoever shall confess in me before men, I too shall confess in him before my Father in the heavens; but whoever shall deny me before men, I too shall deny him before my Father. For whoever shall be ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man too shall be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father's glory with the holy angels.' And Isaiah: 'Be my witnesses, and I witness, saith the Lord God, and the boy whom I chose, that ye may know and believe and understand that I am.' (Isaiah 43:10) To friends, not slaves, these are said — for 'no longer do I call you slaves, but friends.' (John 15:14–15) (Matthew 10:16–33)
